title: IPBES Global Assessment — pollution as a direct driver of biodiversity loss
methodology: Assessment chapter synthesis of pollution and chemical drivers.
limitations: Does not quantify recovery time for a specific contaminated field.

chunks.text: Pollution, including pesticides and nutrient runoff, is a direct driver of biodiversity decline. Chemical pressure reduces sensitive taxa, including pollinators and aquatic species, and interacts with habitat simplification. Reducing emissions and pesticide load while retaining habitat is a combined intervention; pollution control alone does not rebuild habitat structure lost to conversion.
